form.category: Private academic tuition, one-to-one at the tutor's or student's home
form.positioning_sentence: I tutor primary maths and science part-time while studying, and I charge less than anyone else for the same levels.
form.differentiator: I tutor primary maths and science part-time while studying, and I charge less than anyone else for the same levels.
form.undercut_on: I am the cheapest option, which means parents see me as interchangeable with any other part-time tutor. There is nothing else to choose me on.
form.their_price_point: See the derived competitive set for the category ladder.

tier_0_default.why: Free and often adequate. Most students resolve here.

members: part-time tutor at the low end S$25-35/h

tier_2_direct_set.why: Same service: one-to-one and in person. The published rate ladder is the market's own price for each tier.

members: full-time tutors with a track record
tier_3_category_incumbent.why: The rate ladder IS the mental ladder: MOE teachers command S$90-130/h at JC because parents rank curriculum credibility first.

tier_6_indirect.why: Reduces the number of students needing tuition.

derived_competitive_set._rules: HDB/URA Home-Based Business Scheme: small-scale only, operated by residents only, no non-resident employees, no signage or advertising at the premises, no large-scale storage.
